title: Chapter 230: Almost Captured
content:
Chapter 230: Almost Captured

Wang Shuo, who was riding on a horse, stumbled and almost fell to the ground with his horse.

Although he did not fall off the horse, the speed of the charge slowed down.

At this moment, Good opened his bow again and aimed at Wang Shuo.

Wang Shuo's pupils shrank sharply. The distance between the two was still 300 meters, and the distance just now was at least 500 meters. Good's attack range was more than twice that of ordinary archers.

Without caring about much, Wang Shuo held the gun with both hands and prepared to shoot down the arrow.

Close!

Close!

This time Wang Shuo was more prepared. At the moment when the arrow was about to hit him, he swung his hands hard and finally shot down the flying arrow.

However, before Wang Shuo had time to be happy, two more arrows followed.

"Three stars in a row"

Wang Shuo had no time to shoot away the two arrows and was stabbed directly.

"-1100"

"-800"

Wang Shuo was shot down from his horse.

"Lord!"

"Lord!"

...

Gong Zheng and Ayub saw that the situation was not right, and rushed over at the moment when Good shot the arrow.

Seeing Wang Shuo fall off his horse, all the soldiers in Wana Village were sweating and their hearts were in their throats.

And Wang Shuo, who fell to the ground, was also in great pain at the moment.

His health value dropped by nearly half, and most importantly, it hurt!

He had stars in his eyes and was dizzy.

He endured the pain and took a blood recovery pill.

[Blood recovery pill: Immediately restore 1000 health points. 】

This blood recovery pill was made by Wana Village's own doctor, and it was much better than the previous health recovery potion.

One pill was not enough, so Wang Shuo took another one, which made him feel better!

Good was very satisfied when he saw Wang Shuo being shot down from his horse.

He already knew that Wang Shuo was the lord of Wana Village. If he could capture him, he would become a god of war in front of his brothers.

Although he didn't care much about this false reputation, he still had to do it in order to have more time to improve his strength and intimidate his subordinates.

He was unwilling to let go of such a good opportunity.

At this time, Wang Shuo was like a lamb in Good's eyes, and he could be manipulated at will.

Just when Good was about to bend down and lift Wang Shuo up.

Ayub and Gong Zheng were almost there.

But the two of them were still dozens of meters away from Wang Shuo.

It was too late!

Gong Zheng directly abandoned his warhorse, jumped up, and performed "Taishan Pressing the Top".

The release distance of this skill was as far as 50 meters.

Just when Good was bending down, he saw a figure in the distance, drawing an arc in the air, and arrived in an instant.

Good's heart tightened, and he didn't care about grabbing Wang Shuo, and hurriedly crossed his arms in front of his chest to make a defensive posture.

With a clang, Gong Zheng fell from the sky and kicked Gude's chest with his feet. However, Gude's elbows protected his chest and the wrist guards on his arms held Gong Zheng's feet.

This blow was as heavy as a thousand pounds.

Gude's mount was crushed into a pile of flesh and blood on the spot.

Even Gude's feet were deeply sunk into the soil, burying half of his calves.

Wang Shuo also woke up and showed a shocked expression.

And Ayub also slashed at Gude with a knife. It was a rare opportunity, and Ayub even used "Lightning Rising Dragon Strike" directly.

Gude, who was entangled with Gong Zheng, saw another fierce general rushing over, and immediately exerted force with both hands to force Gong Zheng back, and then took out a shield to block Ayub's Qinglong knife.
